categories.evidence: Has the Build system label and modifies contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm for Guix builds.
categories.rationale: Fixes a failure building the macOS codesigning environment under Guix when using Python 3.12. As noted in issue #36421 and commit 82a8c8009a, the build fails before tests run due to missing setuptools and certvalidator importing the removed imp module.
